name: Recursive Teaching Dimension / No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: Every recursive teaching map is no-clashing.
proof: Take a recursive teaching order and, for each concept h, a teaching set T(h) identifying h within the then-current remaining class. For two distinct concepts h,h', assume h is removed first. Then h' is still present when T(h) is chosen, so T(h) is inconsistent with h'. Thus no pair can clash. The same map has width at most $\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H)$, proving $\mathrm{NCTD}(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H)$.
